item.title: Indianapolis man confesses to deadly hit-and-run on North Shadeland Avenue
item.description: Jevontae Wilkins, 25, of Indianapolis, turned himself in after striking a pedestrian with his car on North Shadeland Avenue and killing him. He faces a upcoming date in court, where he could be formally charged with leaving the scene of an accident resulting in death, causing death while intoxicated, and obstruction of justice.

item.title: Work could begin in spring, finish in fall on 2 parks along White River
item.description: Madison County officials have used federal funds to advance plans to build two parks along the White River. Construction could begin in the spring and finish in the fall, according to a roadmap for the project on the county's new Parks & Recreation website.

item.title: Hamilton County Democrats will be short 18 convention delegates
item.description: Hamilton County's Democratic leadership gave the county's election administrator an inaccurate delegate count, resulting in a shortage of 18 delegates for the Indiana Democratic Party Convention.

item.title: 3 die from suspected arson at Monroe County home; suspect in custody
item.description: Two people were found dead and one person died from injuries after a house fire believed to be arson was reported near Bloomington, Indiana. A suspect was taken into custody.

item.title: Deputy describes crash that killed 4 Amish construction workers as ‘horrific’
item.description: A sheriff's deputy talked with News 8's Tim Spears about a crash that killed four people on State Road 67 in Jay County, Indiana. The White House has weighed in on the driver of the semi, a Kyrgyzstan national, who was taken into custody by ICE.

item.title: IMPD launches review of officer’s conduct after video captures traffic stop
item.description: Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department has launched an internal review after a video was circulated on social media of an officer speaking to a juvenile during a traffic stop. The juvenile was arrested for dangerous possession of a firearm.
